instructions: Build a distinctly Scavenger open-front repair workshop from reused household structures, not a Clockwork reskin. Follow the approved appliance-panel lean-to target. Use believable load-bearing timber posts, knee braces and purlins; a one-slope corrugated roof with a short supported eave; chipped cream and blue-green appliance doors; a drawer-front workbench; a visible tool wall; useful tins, a vise and a wire parts basket; and a small patched canvas panel. Preserve a clear front opening and fit the 26 x 20 x 20 inch local presentation envelope. Add no collision, navigation, selection, work-site, or simulation data.
tool: Blender hard-surface miniature asset maker through the RoomScale Art Factory
post_processing: Import the GLB through Godot and check proportional fit and material bindings.
Capture the standard asset, settlement, and human-room production views through the review-only registry.
Pixel-review close and gameplay-distance renders, diagnose target-to-3D transfer, and keep the candidate unpromoted until it beats the current Scavenger presentation.
material_method: Component-modeled Blender geometry with baked tileable color, tangent-normal, and roughness maps for reclaimed wood, chipped appliance enamel, galvanized roofing, and canvas; blackened iron and oxide fasteners use restrained Principled PBR values.

import_configuration.format: GLB with embedded PBR texture maps
import_configuration.up_axis: glTF Y up converted from Blender Z up
